g.text: Proof: RC1–9; GF7–9. Coordinate graph: exact values; singular spectrum: proved asymptotic identities, not a sampled substitute metric.

g.text: Collision path: received web derivation, Section 4 (author not supplied). Full native constants and conductor transfer: programme calculation; ES map: The Clankers.
